d:
Sannata lekar aaya hai NH-79 ki ek khaufnaak kahani, jahan raat ke sannate mein ek police officer ko milti hai ek aisi call, jo saalon purani lagti hai. Ek sunsaan highway, dhund mein gayab hoti gaadiyan aur laal jode mein ek rahasyamayi aurat. Jaise-jaise Alok is raaz ke kareeb pahunchta hai, woh khud ek aise loop mein phans jaata hai jahan har raasta use wahi wapas le aata hai. Kya woh kabhi is sadak se bahar nikal paayega?
Dekhiye Sannata,
